mira (Marketing): quick ask — we need a single-slide benchmark narrative for next week's webinar: spotlight latency vs $/1M and a routing example. keep it tight.

sam (Data Science): I can pull p50/p95 and blended cost for a routing scenario. suggest visuals: scatter (p95 vs cost) + tiny table for routing blend.

anya (Product Marketing): headline should be customer-first: 'Choose the right deployment for your SLO and budget.' two bullets: 1) predictable p95 with dedicated pools, 2) routing + KV caching lowers cost without breaking SLAs.

jonah (Engineering): include variants tested: hosted-standard, dedicated-4xA100, private-qlora-cpu. call out: measurements at 4k context, batching added for cost numbers, disabled for p95.

sam (Data Science): sample numbers I'll finalize tonight:
```
variant,p95_ms,cost_usd_per_1M
hosted,210,46
dedicated,165,29
private-qlora,430,11
```

mira (Marketing): great. ops-bot, kick the bench run for these exact configs. deadline: need charts + copy by tomorrow morning.

ops-bot: benchmark-run #1024 queued by sam — collecting traces and cost logs. https://bench.redwood/1024
